name: MediaLyze
description: Self-hosted technical media analysis for large video and audio collections.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent configuration and SQLite database storage.

paths.name: Primary Media Mount
paths.description: Required read-only media mount. Change the container path to your preferred visible name, but keep it below /media, for example /media/Movies.

paths.name: Movies Media Mount
paths.description: Optional additional read-only media mount. Change the container path to your preferred visible name, but keep it below /media, for example /media/Movies.

paths.name: Shows Media Mount
paths.description: Optional additional read-only media mount. Change the container path to your preferred visible name, but keep it below /media, for example /media/Shows.

paths.name: Music Media Mount
paths.description: Optional additional read-only media mount. Change the container path to your preferred visible name, but keep it below /media, for example /media/Music.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the MediaLyze web interface. The container target port stays 8080.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, for example Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Optional runtime user id. On Unraid, 99 is usually nobody.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Optional runtime group id. On Unraid, 100 is usually users.
